note: Every connector ships DISABLED. Enabling one grants network, program, or data-lake access to a fixed host/program list and must be a deliberate operator decision. Remote capabilities are separate from the offline compute registry and are never auto-approved.

JASPAR PWM retrieval for transcription-factor binding-site scanning.
IUPred2A long-disorder predictions from protein sequences.
EBI HMMER hmmscan submissions against Pfam.
NCBI Entrez gene summaries; NCBI terms of service apply.
BioMart orthologue conversion between Ensembl gene identifiers.
MUSCLE multiple-sequence alignment feeding the offline phylogeny tool.
MACS2 ChIP-seq peak calling on workspace alignment files.
pLannotate plasmid feature annotation from FASTA input.
DDInter drug-interaction database files (interaction_matrix.json, name_mapping.json) placed by the operator; never bundled with Proto.
